facts.text: I took my niece to the Natural History Museum to see the "Dinosaur Fossils" exhibition today.
My niece loved the life-sized T-Rex replica at the Natural History Museum.
I have been to the Metropolitan Museum of Art recently to see the Ancient Egyptian Artifacts exhibition.
I was impressed by the golden mask of Pharaoh Tutankhamun at the Metropolitan Museum of Art.
I am thinking of taking my niece to the Children's Museum next.
I attended a guided tour of the Modern Art Museum's newest installation, "The Evolution of Abstract Expressionism".
I was moved by the large-scale installation by Anselm Kiefer at the Modern Art Museum.
I attended a lecture series recently at the Museum of Contemporary Art.
Dr. Maria Rodriguez spoke about the role of feminist art in the 1970s at the Museum of Contemporary Art lecture series.
I enjoyed networking with other art enthusiasts during the reception that followed the Museum of Contemporary Art lecture series.
